name: player_rebuild_orientation_from_normal
description: Player::RebuildOrientationFromNormal rebuilds steering raw basis, vehicle pitch/roll, and motion basis from the current support normal.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player post-move environment cluster pass so _CIasin x87 calling, Vec3RotateY stack argument shape, and MatBuildEulerRotation3x3 caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42da40 validates steerBasisRef.y zero guard, raw-basis reconstruction from steerBasisNorm and steerBasisRef, Vec3Normalize, storage to steerBasisRaw, Vec3RotateY of steerBasisRef by -restartYawRad, pitch asin(rotated.z), roll asin(-rotated.x), MatBuildEulerRotation3x3, and copying worldPos to motionBasis translation.
The native smoke verifies raw-basis reconstruction, pitch/roll extraction, motion-basis translation, and the zero-Y normal guard.
